## 🎯 Program Overview

**Duration:** 23 Weeks (~5.5 Months)
**Format:** 2 × 1.5h lectures/week (Theory + Walkthrough) + 4–6 hrs/week practice
**Outcome:** Capstone-ready ML practitioner with theory-based modeling skills, practical pipelines, and a professional portfolio.

---

## 📅 Week-by-Week Curriculum

### Week 1 — ML Foundations & Workflow

- What is ML? Supervised vs Unsupervised vs Reinforcement Learning
- The ML pipeline: framing → data → modeling → evaluation → deployment
- Overview of prediction tasks (regression, classification)
- Setting up the Python environment: Jupyter, Anaconda, virtual environments

**Math Tools:** Vectors, matrices, dot product, Probability basics, Bayes' theorem

**Practice:** Titanic dataset EDA; Python/NumPy crash course
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 1, I2ML Introduction, DeepLearningBook Ch. 2–3

---

### Week 2 — Data Preprocessing & Pipelines

- Handling missing data, detecting outliers
- Encoding: one-hot, label, ordinal
- Normalization vs standardization
- Building Scikit-learn Pipelines

**Practice:** California Housing preprocessing pipeline; Ridge Regression from scratch
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 2–4

---

### Week 3 — Math & Information Theory

- Linear algebra review: vectors, dot products, matrix multiplication
- Probability: conditional, Bayes' theorem
- Entropy, cross-entropy, mutual information

**Practice:** Math + probability notebooks; Khan Academy modules
**Reading:** DeepLearningBook Ch. 2–3

---

### Week 4 — Linear Models for Regression

- Linear Regression: formula, interpretation, closed-form solution
- Polynomial regression
- Loss functions: MSE, MAE; Regularization: Ridge, Lasso
- Bias–variance tradeoff

**Practice:** Housing price prediction; polynomial regression
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 4, I2ML Ch. 5

---

### Week 5 — Logistic Regression & Classification

- Logistic function, decision boundaries, sigmoid
- Binary vs multiclass: One-vs-Rest, One-vs-One
- Cross-entropy loss

**Practice:** Titanic and Iris classification
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 3, I2ML Ch. 7

---

### Week 6 — Model Evaluation

- Regression metrics: MAE, MSE, RMSE, R²
- Classification metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score
- ROC, AUC, PR curves; cross-validation strategies

**Practice:** Compare models using multiple metrics; ROC and PR curves
**Reading:** I2ML Ch. 8, sklearn.metrics docs

---

### Week 7 — Bias–Variance Tradeoff

- Underfitting vs overfitting; bias-variance decomposition
- Learning curves, validation curves

**Practice:** Bias–variance analysis with synthetic data
**Reading:** I2ML Ch. 6

---

### Week 8 — Data Sampling & Validation Techniques

- Hold-out split, stratified sampling
- Cross-validation: k-fold, LOOCV
- Bootstrap and confidence intervals

**Practice:** CV + grid search for model selection
**Reading:** I2ML Ch. 9

---

### Week 9 — k-Nearest Neighbors

- KNN for regression and classification
- Distance metrics and scaling sensitivity
- Curse of dimensionality

**Practice:** KNN from scratch and with sklearn
**Reading:** I2ML Ch. 10

---

### Week 10 — Decision Trees

- Splitting criteria: Gini, Entropy
- Tree growth, pruning, overfitting
- Interpreting tree decisions

**Practice:** Build and visualize decision trees on tabular data
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 6

---

### Week 11 — Random Forests & Bagging

- Bagging: theory and bias reduction
- Random Forests: feature bagging, OOB error
- Feature importance

**Practice:** Feature ranking using Random Forest
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 7

---

### Week 12 — Boosting Algorithms

- Boosting concepts: ensemble of weak learners
- AdaBoost and Gradient Boosting
- Early stopping and learning rate

**Practice:** Compare boosting to random forest
**Reading:** I2ML Ch. 13

---

### Week 13 — Modern Boosting Libraries

- XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost
- Handling missing values and categorical features
- Hyperparameter tuning strategies

**Practice:** Benchmark all 3 libraries on the same dataset
**Reading:** Library documentation

---

### Week 14 — Feature Engineering & Feature Selection

- Custom transformers, interaction features
- Encoding strategies: frequency, target
- Selection: filter, wrapper, embedded methods

**Practice:** Ames housing dataset with custom pipeline
**Reading:** Géron pipeline section, I2ML Ch. 10

---

### Week 15 — Imbalanced & Noisy Data

- Resampling: SMOTE, undersampling
- Weighted loss, cost-sensitive learning
- Detecting and mitigating noisy labels

**Practice:** Credit card fraud or churn prediction
**Reading:** I2ML Ch. 15

---

### Week 16 — Clustering & Dimensionality Reduction

- Clustering: K-Means, DBSCAN, Hierarchical
- PCA: explained variance, reconstruction
- t-SNE, UMAP for visualization

**Practice:** Customer segmentation pipeline
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 8

---

### Week 17 — Neural Networks & MLPs

- Perceptron, hidden layers, activation functions (ReLU, sigmoid, tanh)
- Forward and backpropagation; gradient descent, Adam optimizer
- Regularization: dropout, L2

**Practice:** MLP in NumPy; MNIST classification with Keras
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 10–11, CS231n backprop notes

---

### Week 18 — CNNs & Image Classification

- Convolution, pooling, deep architectures (LeNet, AlexNet, VGG)
- Transfer learning: feature extraction vs fine-tuning
- Data augmentation; Keras Applications (ResNet, Inception)

**Practice:** CIFAR-10 / Fashion MNIST; custom dataset with transfer learning
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 14, TensorFlow CNN guide

---

### Week 19 — NLP & Time Series

- NLP: tokenization, stemming, TF-IDF, Word2Vec, GloVe
- Time series: lag features, moving averages, trends
- Introduction to RNNs and LSTMs

**Practice:** IMDB sentiment classification; stock price forecasting with LSTM
**Reading:** Géron Ch. 15–16, TensorFlow NLP + time series docs

---

### Week 20 — Full ML Pipeline: Mini Project

- Dataset selection and objective definition
- End-to-end: cleaning → modeling → evaluation → documentation
- Document assumptions, limitations, and improvements

**Practice:** Build a complete ML project from scratch

---

### Week 21 — Capstone Development (Part 1)

- Final project scoping and planning
- Dataset curation, baseline models
- Peer review and mentoring checkpoints

---

### Week 22 — Capstone Development (Part 2)

- Full modeling and evaluation pipeline
- Documentation: README, notebooks, visualizations
- Polish, test, and finalize

---

### Week 23 — Capstone Presentations & Career Prep

- Project showcase and peer feedback
- Portfolio walkthrough (GitHub + Notion)
- Interview preparation: model choices, metrics, trade-offs

**Bonus Reading:** Chip Huyen – *Designing ML Systems*, Burkov – *The ML Engineering Book*

---

| Resume Matcher | NLP |
| Car Price Estimator | Regression |
